name: Masumi Ai
source:
[spoiler]Her name "Ai" is written as "哀", meaning sadness, sorrow, and pity.[/spoiler]

A girl who calls herself a "sinner" who came to the small village of Tamasato to repent her sins. Upon finding out about [url=/c36919]Yuuto’s[/url] loneliness, Ai confided that she was abandoned by her parents. Gradually, they started dating, but, [spoiler]due to circumstances, rapidly broke up[/spoiler].
